approvedBy: Jordan, after reviewing the contact sheets

sizing.measure: glass height mm (heightWithoutCap, foot to rim)

landmarkRule.shouldered: Glass shoulder = neck base: the row where the glass widens out of the neck, i.e. where a fitted collar/cap skirt meets the glass. Same line the released Cylinder/Elegant/Diva locks sit on.
landmarkRule.shoulderless: Closure seat = the highest point of the glass body that stays visible with the closure fitted, i.e. where the closure or stopper lower edge meets the glass. Ground-glass stoppers (Genie, Eternal Flame, Pear): top of the glass lip. Screw/cap necks (Tola, Heart): neck base under the cap skirt. Metal-shell bottles (Marble, 14 ml Royal): top of the shell top-plate where the stopper cap rests.
landmarkRule.input: Target % comes from glass mm (heightWithoutCap, foot to rim) through the curve for both kinds, exactly as the approved locks were read.

qaGate: IoU >= 0.995 and smoothed edge p99 <= 4 px vs the master PSD input silhouette, plus by-eye shadow/material check
background: Generated bone treatment retained; pixel-exact background not claimed
